remarks:
This beautifully remodeled, spacious residence provides the unique opportunity to combine both home and business. Located in the desirable Village of Lakewood, the property is positioned in a well-trafficked, easily accessible location. The front portion of the building has historically been leased out as a dental office but could accommodate other professional uses.
At the left entry point, you will be welcomed to the private single family home with 2 car garage. Once inside, you'll be impressed by the thoughtful renovation & extensive upgrades throughout the home. Features include a bright, open-concept layout seamlessly connecting the updated kitchen, dining, & living areas—ideal for everyday living & entertaining. Enjoy views of the backyard from the large living room and cozy around the gas fireplace. Enjoy casual meals in the eat-in kitchen or dine around the formal dining table or beyond to the deck!
The expansive first floor primary suite provides privacy, complete with ensuite bath and a generous walk-in closet. Wind your way upstairs to 3 add'l bedrooms all featuring sky lights, a full bath and an abundance of storage. A standout feature of this property is the large in-home professional office space—perfect for remote work or running a small business right from home. This space offers its own private entrance, accessible from the driveway, or directly attached to the home for added convenience.
Step outside to your own private retreat! The oversized deck overlooks a fully fenced backyard, ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or cozy evenings around the fire pit. With woods behind the property & a wooded park to the side, you’ll appreciate the peaceful setting & privacy.
Add'l highlights include an attached garage with off-street parking, making this property as practical as it is charming. With R2 zoning, a variety of options are available for use & the professional space could easily provide passive income to the homeowner. Village of Lakewood zoning guidelines attached. 
Whether you're seeking an investment property or a residence with a professional workspace, or both, this exceptional home offers the versatility and location to meet your needs.
